settings_updates_channel_about_aria: Accessible name of the info icon next to the Update channel title; its tooltip explains the three channels.
settings_updates_channel_alpha_cadence: Channel copy mapped at display time by the channel id `alpha`: how often Alpha builds come out. The English equals `cadence` of crates/atlas-core/data/channels.json (a contract test compares them); the CLI prints the same text.
settings_updates_channel_alpha_label: Channel copy mapped by the id `alpha`: the name on the channel selector, the release train lane and the Alpha badges. A product lane name; the English equals `label` of channels.json.
settings_updates_channel_alpha_promise: Channel copy mapped by the id `alpha`: what the channel promises, under the selector. The English equals `promise` of channels.json and of docs/versioning.md. main is the git branch.
settings_updates_channel_alpha_risk: Channel copy mapped by the id `alpha`: the risk tag next to the promise. The English equals `risk_label` of channels.json.
settings_updates_channel_alpha_switch_to: Channel copy mapped by the id `alpha`: what switching to the channel means, in the confirmation panel. The English equals `switch_to` of channels.json.
settings_updates_channel_beta_cadence: Channel copy mapped by the id `beta`: how often betas come out. The English equals `cadence` of channels.json.
settings_updates_channel_beta_label: Channel copy mapped by the id `beta`: the name on the channel selector, the release train lane and the Beta badges. The English equals `label` of channels.json.
settings_updates_channel_beta_promise: Channel copy mapped by the id `beta`: what the channel promises, under the selector. The English equals `promise` of channels.json and of docs/versioning.md.
settings_updates_channel_beta_risk: Channel copy mapped by the id `beta`: the risk tag next to the promise. The English equals `risk_label` of channels.json.
settings_updates_channel_beta_switch_to: Channel copy mapped by the id `beta`: what switching to the channel means, in the confirmation panel. release candidate stays English (a glossary exception). The English equals `switch_to` of channels.json.
settings_updates_channel_env_forced: Notice shown when ATLAS_UPDATE_CHANNEL fixes the channel, so the selector is locked. {#b} wraps {channel}, the channel's display name; {#code} wraps the variable name, which stays verbatim.
settings_updates_channel_follow: Confirm button of the channel switch panel. {label} is the channel's display name (Stable, Beta, Alpha).

settings_updates_channel_installed.description: Small tag on the channel selector's description when the running build was cut for that channel. The channel is the subject (masculine in Portuguese); the release badge in What's new is a different key.
settings_updates_channel_installed.distinct: Marks a channel (masculine in Portuguese); the agent installed state and the release badge are other subjects.

settings_updates_channel_loading_aria: Accessible name of the placeholder shown while the channel list loads.
settings_updates_channel_offer_none: Line under the channel promise when the channel offers nothing newer than the running build.
settings_updates_channel_offer_unknown: Line under the channel promise when what the channel offers could not be read (offline).
settings_updates_channel_offers: Line under the channel promise: the newer version the channel offers. {offered} is a version.
settings_updates_channel_offers_older: Line under the channel promise: the channel offers an older version than the running one. {offered} is a version.
settings_updates_channel_offline: Notice with a Retry button when the live offers of the channels could not be fetched; the cards still render from copy.
settings_updates_channel_older_body: Body of the warning when the chosen channel offers an older build. {label} is the channel name, {version} the older version. The data-loss warning follows as its own sentence.
settings_updates_channel_older_title: Title of the warning when the chosen channel offers an older build. {label} is the channel name.
settings_updates_channel_stable_alpha_er: Channel copy mapped by the id `stable`: a note shown while Atlas is in alpha. The English equals `alpha_era_note` of channels.json.
settings_updates_channel_stable_cadence: Channel copy mapped by the id `stable`: how often Stable releases come out. The English equals `cadence` of channels.json.
settings_updates_channel_stable_label: Channel copy mapped by the id `stable`: the name on the channel selector, the release train lane and the badges. The English equals `label` of channels.json.
settings_updates_channel_stable_promise: Channel copy mapped by the id `stable`: what the channel promises, under the selector. The English equals `promise` of channels.json and of docs/versioning.md.
settings_updates_channel_stable_risk: Channel copy mapped by the id `stable`: the risk tag next to the promise. The English equals `risk_label` of channels.json.
settings_updates_channel_stable_switch_t: Channel copy mapped by the id `stable`: what switching to the channel means, in the confirmation panel. The English equals `switch_to` of channels.json.
settings_updates_channel_stage_alpha_not: Product stage note mapped by the stage id `alpha` and shown above the channel selector. The English equals `stage_note` of channels.json.
settings_updates_channel_switch_to_aria: Accessible name of the inline confirmation panel after a channel is picked. {label} is the channel name.
settings_updates_channel_title: Title of the update channel group in Settings > General > Updates, also the accessible name of its selector.
settings_updates_channel_tooltip: Tooltip of the info icon next to the Update channel title: one sentence per channel.
settings_updates_channel_train_alpha: Accessible description of the release train diagram while Alpha is followed. alpha, beta and stable are lane names in lowercase inside a sentence.
settings_updates_channel_train_beta: Accessible description of the release train diagram while Beta is followed. alpha, beta and stable are lane names in lowercase inside a sentence.
settings_updates_channel_train_stable: Accessible description of the release train diagram while Stable is followed. alpha, beta and stable are lane names in lowercase inside a sentence.
settings_updates_channel_train_title: Accessible title of the diagram that shows builds moving from the alpha lane to beta to stable (not visible text).
